thread:
Jon: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GTM playbook and partner commitments. Wanted to capture a couple of asks so we can action them before EOD.
Maria: thanks — can you list the asks you want prioritized?
Jon: sure. Top 3: 1) exact timeline for partner pilot enablement, 2) owner for the partner marketplace spec, 3) sales enablement kit ETA for Q2.
Tara: for the pilot timeline — we're targeting a 6-week ramp starting April 10. that's dependent on integrations team capacity.
Kevin: pinging @Tara — do we have any blockers on the infra side for sandbox partner environments?
Tara: no infra blockers; just need final model gating from Research for data handling. Maria mentioned that was happening this week.
Maria: correct — research sign-off on PII filters expected by Friday. once that's in, integrations can start provisioning.
Linda: on marketplace spec ownership — I'm happy to co-own with Product Marketing. Alex can you confirm PM lead?
Alex: yep, I can be PM lead. Linda + Alex to own spec. will draft an outline by Wed. :memo:
Jon: great. can we add that as an action item with owners+due dates? helps sales know when to route partner opportunities.
Kevin: sales enablement kit — Sales Ops will assemble baseline assets, but we need feature matrix and approved pricing decks from Product. Maria, any timeline?
Maria: putting pricing deck in draft today. expect review cycle next Tue. feature matrix I'll share by Monday.
Sam: capturing actions in the GTM board now. summary:
- Pilot timeline: 6-week ramp from 2026-04-10 (Owner: Tara)
- Marketplace spec: outline by 2026-03-18 (Owners: Alex, Linda)
- Sales enablement kit: draft packs by 2026-03-23 (Owners: Kevin, Sales Ops, Product)
Jon: perfect. couple more clarifying Qs — will pilot partners get dedicated SLAs or be on shared Dedicated pool?
Maria: pilot will be on shared Dedicated pool with bumped priority, not full reserved capacity. we wanted to reduce cost while keeping performance predictable.
Linda: partners asking about co-marketing. do we have a standard MKT collateral template?
Alex: not yet — I'll add a basic co-marketing template to the marketplace spec outline.
Jon: thanks. last thing: can someone confirm who fields inbound partnership leads while we spin up Partner Success?
Kevin: Sales Ops will triage inbound for next 4 weeks. I'll share the routing playbook.
ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands follow-up doc has been posted to #company-wiki by Maria. Link: https://wiki/redwood/allhands/2026-03-12
Maria: added meeting notes and the partner action list. please add comments directly on the doc.
Jon: awesome — will review and close out open items. thanks everyone :handshake:
